title: Include event_type in get-all-events serializers
body:
## Summary
- Add `event_type` (`"internal"` | `"external"`) to the response of `get_all_events` and `get_all_events_paginated`
- Enables downstream clients (e.g. AFC Discord bot) to distinguish AFC-run events from externally-hosted ones
- Pure additive change — no existing field renamed or removed

## Why
The bot needs to skip announcements for externally-hosted events. The `event_type` field already exists on the `Event` model (choices: `internal`/`external`) but was not being serialized.

## Test plan
- [ ] `curl /events/get-all-events/` returns `event_type` on every event
- [ ] `curl /events/get-all-events-paginated/` returns `event_type` on every event
- [ ] Existing clients keep working (additive change)
